meta.title: Daybreak Overture - Havoc's Message
meta.description: I'll build a place where we can live together with all my might. I want to see the future with you and the Oasis.

units.rawText: There you are, Professor. I've been beside myself waiting for you!
units.displayText: There you are, Professor. I've been beside myself waiting for you!

spans.text: There you are, Professor. I've been beside myself waiting for you!

units.rawText: Come on, I had to go to some crazy lengths to convince Boss to let me come over to the Oasis. Then you, the employer, go and run off. That leaves me all by myself, y'see?
units.displayText: Come on, I had to go to some crazy lengths to convince Boss to let me come over to the Oasis. Then you, the employer, go and run off. That leaves me all by myself, y'see?

spans.text: Come on, I had to go to some crazy lengths to convince Boss to let me come over to the Oasis. Then you, the employer, go and run off. That leaves me all by myself, y'see?

units.rawText: But don't you worry! I haven't been slacking!
units.displayText: But don't you worry! I haven't been slacking!

spans.text: But don't you worry! I haven't been slacking!

units.rawText: I've been fulfilling my duty perfectly all this time, just to give you a surprise when you returned!
units.displayText: I've been fulfilling my duty perfectly all this time, just to give you a surprise when you returned!

spans.text: I've been fulfilling my duty perfectly all this time, just to give you a surprise when you returned!

units.rawText: Look, a brand new Oasis, completed in its entirety! More than half of it is my work, you know!
units.displayText: Look, a brand new Oasis, completed in its entirety! More than half of it is my work, you know!

spans.text: Look, a brand new Oasis, completed in its entirety! More than half of it is my work, you know!

units.rawText: ...All of the work I've done feels worth it after seeing that smile on your face.
units.displayText: ...All of the work I've done feels worth it after seeing that smile on your face.

spans.text: ...All of the work I've done feels worth it after seeing that smile on your face.

units.rawText: Let me show you around, alright? Shall we head to the commercial district or to the plaza first?
units.displayText: Let me show you around, alright? Shall we head to the commercial district or to the plaza first?

spans.text: Let me show you around, alright? Shall we head to the commercial district or to the plaza first?

units.rawText: Before we get to the contractual details, I want to be with you for a bit, so you can see just what I've done for the rebuilding of the Oasis.
units.displayText: Before we get to the contractual details, I want to be with you for a bit, so you can see just what I've done for the rebuilding of the Oasis.

spans.text: Before we get to the contractual details, I want to be with you for a bit, so you can see just what I've done for the rebuilding of the Oasis.

units.rawText: It's due payment that you've made me wait so long for... That isn't so ridiculous, is it?
units.displayText: It's due payment that you've made me wait so long for... That isn't so ridiculous, is it?

spans.text: It's due payment that you've made me wait so long for... That isn't so ridiculous, is it?
